description: Search television news closed captions for spoken mentions of a query. Returns a bounded, paged per-station time series showing airtime devoted to the topic — 500 points by default, up to 20,000 per page. Each series carries GDELT's display name for the station and, when that name resolves to one, the station ID gdelt_get_tv_clips takes as stations. Use stations to select station IDs (e.g. ["CNN", "FOXNEWS", "MSNBC"]), or select with station:, network:, or quoted market: operators in query. TV query also supports in-query operators: station:CNN, network:CBS, market:"National", show:"Anderson Cooper 360", context:"vaccine". Archive coverage varies by station; use gdelt_list_tv_stations for station IDs, network and market values, and monitoring date ranges.

combined.description: Pool selected stations into one Combined timeline. Normalized values divide pooled matching clips by pooled monitored clips; false keeps separate station series.

dateres.description: Optional GDELT aggregation resolution. Omit to let GDELT choose from the query window; the effective recognized or inferred resolution is returned as dateResolution.

endDatetime.description: End datetime in GDELT format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS — exactly 14 digits, no separators (e.g. 20200131235959). Must pair with startDatetime; supplying only one of the two is rejected.

limit.description: Maximum timeline points returned per page (default 500, cap 20,000). Larger counts clamp with limitClamp; strict deployments reject them.

normalize.description: When true (default), values are normalized as % of total airtime, enabling cross-station comparison. When false, returns raw matching 15-second clip counts.

offset.description: Zero-based point offset into the deterministic date-then-station-name ordering. Use nextOffset from the preceding response with the same query inputs to retrieve the next page.

query.description: Search query for TV transcript content. Supports TV operators: station:CNN, network:CBS, market:"National", show:"Anderson Cooper", context:"vaccine". Boolean OR and phrase operators also work.

smoothing.description: Trailing moving-average width in timesteps, 0–30 (0 or 1 = none). Width N needs N source steps; leading steps cannot produce averages and peaks may appear later.

startDatetime.description: Start datetime in GDELT format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS — exactly 14 digits, no separators (e.g. 20200101000000). Must pair with endDatetime; supplying only one of the two is rejected.

stations.description: Station IDs to filter to (e.g. ["CNN", "FOXNEWS", "MSNBC"]). Every supplied ID is forwarded. Alternatively use station:, network:, or quoted market: selectors in query; a selector is required. Obtain IDs, network and market values, and per-station archive ranges from gdelt_list_tv_stations.

timespan.description: Time window, e.g. "1m", "6m", "1y". Ignored when startDatetime/endDatetime are set. Check station monitoring dates with gdelt_list_tv_stations.

name: gdelt_search_tv

combined.description: True for one pooled Combined timeline; false for separate station series.

dateResolution.description: Temporal resolution of data points — as GDELT reported it, as requested via dateres, or inferred from the returned intervals. Omitted when none of those can establish it.

effectiveQuery.description: Echoed query string for use in follow-up calls.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: Only one of startDatetime / endDatetime was supplied, one of them is not a real UTC calendar timestamp, or startDatetime is not earlier than endDatetime. `offset_out_of_range`: The requested point offset is at or beyond the end of a non-empty timeline. `invalid_query`: GDELT rejected the query — no station was selected, or the query string is malformed. `gdelt_rate_limited`: GDELT rejected the request for its one-request-per-five-seconds limit, or too many requests were already queued for this one to start in time. `gdelt_unavailable`: GDELT TV API is unreachable or temporarily returned no usable data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Maximum points this page holds — the requested limit, or 20,000 when a larger one was clamped.

limitClamp.description: Present only when the requested count exceeded the per-call cap: the call ran exactly as a call at the cap, and every count, notice, and continuation in this response reflects the applied value.

applied.description: The per-call cap the call ran with instead.

parameter.description: The count input that was clamped.

requested.description: The value the call asked for.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page using the same query inputs. Absent when this is the final page.

normalized.description: True when values are normalized coverage percentages.

notice.description: Guidance when the query matched no TV coverage — the resolved timespan window, the October 2024 archive cutoff, and how to check station coverage. When a returned series has no station ID, why: GDELT returned it without a station label, or its station catalog did not load or has no entry for the named label — with how to look the ID up. Absent when coverage was returned and every series carries its station ID.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of this point page.

series.description: Station series represented in this point page.

items.description: Coverage time series for a single station.

data.description: Time-ordered coverage data for this station.

value.description: Coverage value (normalized % or raw matching 15-second clip count).

station.description: Station ID — the value the stations input and the station: operator take (e.g. "FOXNEWS"). Absent when GDELT's label for the station could not be resolved to an ID; notice says why.

stationName.description: GDELT's display label for the station (e.g. "FOX News"). Empty when GDELT returned the series without one; notice says so.

staleResponse.description: Present only when the refetch of this exact request was refused, failed, or came back empty, and the response is GDELT's stored answer from fetchedAt instead. It holds nothing published after fetchedAt; a relative timespan covers the window ending at fetchedAt, not now. Absent on a live answer.

ageSeconds.description: Age of the stored answer when served, in whole seconds.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 time GDELT returned the stored answer.

reason.description: Why the refetch was not used: GDELT rate-limited it, did not answer with data, or answered empty — which GDELT also does under load.

timeRange.description: Date range spanned by this returned point page. Omitted when the page is empty.

end.description: Latest date in the returned data.

start.description: Earliest date in the returned data.

totalPoints.description: Total points available across all matched station series before pagination.

title: Search GDELT TV News
